### 1. Project

Example Client intends to extend School extension (Class 9b) at 1 Example St, Example NSW.

| The building | Site and planning | Delivery |
|---|---|---|
| Work type: Extension / addition | Site address: 1 Example St, Example NSW | Client: Example Client |
| Building: School extension: Class 9b | Planning pathway: Development application (DA) | Procurement route: Design and construct; later stages and novation require separate appointment. |

Conditions that apply: Neighbouring or street trees affected; Lawful offsite tree access confirmed; Works affect trees roots or canopy; Tree pruning removal or clearance proposed; Work to an existing building; Site stays occupied or operating during the works; Delivered in stages.
Conditions that do not apply: Heritage item or conservation area.

Information provided: Survey DWG, tree IDs/ownership, current works drawings and conditions; access permissions with explicit limits.

### 2. Scope of services

Assess scheduled trees and advise within competence. Client/approval lead obtains permissions; competent tree-work contractor executes pruning/removal/protection. Advice grants no permission, survival or future-safety guarantee; escalate urgent concerns.
Coordinate survey, landscape, civil, structure and utilities; retain their design duties. Revision-controlled PDF/CAD plans, calculations and editable registers state observed/measured/reported/inferred basis, access limits, recipients and reliance.
Tree basis: Confirm survey/DWG revision, IDs/count/ownership, inaccessible trees, works/access/laydown footprints, services, current controls/editions and permission owner.

I = included; O = optional price; X = excluded; ? = scope unknown. Resolve unknown scope before issue; propose departures in R6.

| Scope of services | I | O | X | ? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tree evidence and impacts — Onsite tree survey/condition assessment; method, date and uncertainty stated | X |  |  |  |
| Neighbour/street trees; ownership, referrals and access limits; inaccessible trees retained with confidence limits | X |  |  |  |

| Existing/occupied/staged/remediation baseline, access constraints and temporary-protection advice; S3 plan separate; investigate before root attribution, structure/geotech diagnose | X |  |  |  |

### 4. Allowances

Allocate counts by service/stage; each quantity needs its own unit/duration. Complete or authorise priced assumptions with owner/date/consequence/review point. Fixed fee, time ceiling or unit rate/quantity; options/dependencies separate.

| Item | Allowance |
|---|---|
| Tree coverage | 2 trees by ID/ownership; additional trees, area/alternatives and ground visits/duration |
| Reports / rounds | 2 report/plan issues, draft/final rounds, meetings/duration, authority responses and RFI ceiling |
| Investigation / risk | 2 methods/trees/samples, equipment/specialist hours; access/permits/locating/reinstatement and formal-risk extent |
| Works / monitoring | 2 pre-start/hold-point/completion visits, notice/callout and repeat-inspection duration/visits |
| Period / extras | 2 service months; additional tree/visit/revision rates, travel/out-of-hours, delay/abortive visit/remobilisation |

### 5. Terms

- Attached Project arborist agreement (attached), agreed fees/scope, numbered addenda and written acceptance govern; settle precedence. RFP does not authorise work; no automatic supplier terms, guarantees or asset security.
- Before extra scope/ceiling overrun or rate/fee/program change, obtain representative written authority with reason, scope, basis and time effect; agree delay/aborted-visit/remobilisation consequences.
- Signed brief/revisions set baseline; agreed coordination, rounds, routine administration and normal development included. Distinguish clarification from changed design/evidence.
- Correct own errors without extra fee; reasonable professional skill/care within competence. Evidence limits do not negate agreed duties.
- Payment 30 days after correct invoice for agreed services; state milestones/GST. Declare deposits, report-release restrictions, interest, recovery, security and suspension departures.
- State rates/fixed period and all third-party/travel/access costs; agree changes before work. Historical prices are not the budget.
- Proposal valid 90 days from closing. Set project insurance and agreement choices before appointment.
- Issue numbered addenda to all tenderers, acknowledged in proposal.
- Agree project/team/authority/operator use, third-party reliance, native files/retention/handover and confidentiality; marketing needs consent. Resolve IP, caps/indemnities, law/disputes, assignment/novation and notice/cure/suspension/termination in agreement.

### Returnable schedules: reply using this structure only

R2 Deliverables list: Reports, IDs/registers, plans/CAD, calculations, methods and inspection/completion records: purpose/extent, revisions, formats, recipients/reliance, rounds and dates.
R3 Hourly rates: Role/additional tree/visit/revision/investigation rates; meetings/responses/visits/durations/hold points/rounds and monitoring limits; travel/callout/cancellation and approval before overruns.
R4 Team: Lead/reviewer, stage resources, competence, investigators/subcontractors/conflicts and tree-contractor affiliations; permission/survey/landscape/civil/structure/utilities interfaces; substitutions and ISO/equivalent QA.
R5 Experience: Two or three comparable tree/works constraints, ownership/access, investigations and construction interfaces; named personnel roles, outputs, lessons and referees.
R6 Departures: Sections 2–5 and agreement departures: reason, alternative, fee/time and decision or nil; unknown/conflicting facts or authorised assumption with owner/date/consequence/review point; name excluded-work parties.
R7 Program: Input/access providers/dates, stage resources and field/draft/review/final milestones; authority dependencies/hold-point notice. Survey reconciliation, calculation/risk/test methods/limits, urgent escalation and condition closure.
R8 Insurance and compliance: Current PI Client-selected $5m; PL Client-selected $20m; workers cover and required duration. Declare activity/height exclusions and renewals; match offered consulting/investigation; agreement/precedence acceptance or numbered departures.
R9 Reimbursables: Travel/access/permits, survey/locating, testing/lab/equipment, traffic controls, tree contractors/reinstatement and documents: quantity, included/allowance/unit basis, payer/GST/markup/prior approval; no R1 duplication.
